notes.title: Things are going to change
notes.content:
We're back!

Guess it’s been too long since our last announcement. Sorry that we can’t deliver the content update as promised.
Things happened, and we had to pause the development for almost 2 months.

Long story short, we're sort of burned out, and decided to cool ourselves with a long break after a whole year of development. 

We also had a discussion about the future of this project, and we came up with some conclusions that we need to tell you.
It might upset some, but in the end it’s what is best for the dev team and the continuation of this project.


EC2 is now free
[For those who already purchased the game, you can contact us to get the DLC for free when it's available.]

Yes, this game will already cost nothing once Steam approves the price change (It takes about one week to process).
Some of you might have a bad image of "Free to Play" model, but we can assure you that it doesn't mean this game will be a money-grabbing gacha game.
Just like our previous title, you can complete Epic Conquest 2 in several days without spending anything. Of course, once the game is 100% completed.

We'll have some DLC in the form of cosmetics, HQ artwork, music pack, etc if you're willing to support the developer. And that's that. No paywall to enjoy and finish the game.
There might still be some sort of premium items, but we'll make sure that you can get it just by grinding. Or, if it's not available to grind, it's an item that won't put you in a great disadvantage if you don't have it.

But why tho
We just realized that this style of development (paid early access) doesn’t suit us at all. It feels like we're being burdened by responsibility in every sale we made. We end up doing things in a hurry, rather than enjoying the process in our own pace and polishing every bit of the game. Therefore, we decided to return to our old and comfy way, that is more enjoyable for us to continue the development.

Apparently, what makes us most motivated is simply to have more people enjoy our creation. And if some people decide to support us along the way (not just in money. we also accept morale support :p), that would greatly help us stay motivated and always do our best!


We're working on Mobile version
Right now, there are so many players from the first Epic Conquest (currently with over 4mil installs), patiently waiting this project to be completed, and published to android.
At first, we said that it will be ready by the end of 2021. But looking at how slow the development progress can be, we don't think we can finish it on time.
They've supported us over the year, and making them wait even longer just doesn't sit right.

Therefore, we decided to support both platforms (PC and android) at the same time, even if it takes more work and time. 
Of course this will impact the game itself, but we don't think it will be much different from EC2 at its current state.


====================

So, once again, We're very sorry for the slow updates.
If you have some questions, just ask here.

notes.title: Development Progress [v0.2.0]
notes.content:
30 days since the last update. How's the development going?

As you probably guessed, a new character is joining the party! 
But because we took a long time to make this new character, the next version [v0.2.0] will only cover a tiny bit of story progression.

2nd region (Desert) will be covered in v0.2.1, thus the next tier of equipment won't be available for now as it will be harder for us to preserve the 2nd region difficulty.


So, what's coming in v0.2.0?
[previewyoutube=4iDWX1G-7gc;full][/previewyoutube]

Release date?
We need several more weeks to do some polishing, and doing some math and testing to balance the numbers. And of course, to write the story and cutscenes.
We will announce it later.


==============
Additional things that are not mentioned in the video.

Changed Controls
As you can see, PS4 button mapping is now supported.

And there's a change in the controller scheme, "Interact/Item Pick" will be moved to (Y/Triangle) button as it's a more common approach in games nowadays, and not to confuse players because it has the same function as "Cancel" button.

And "Special (Resonance Mode)" button is of course moved to (B/O). People who already played with controllers before need to adjust to this new control, but we think it's for the better.

Thanks to Noco for pointing this out.


Working on the feedback
The upcoming update also comes with various bug fixes and difficulty balancing that we've collected. So if you have more things to report, we can fix more things in v0.2.0.


Thank You~

notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE [v0.1.3]
notes.content:
New content is up guys! This update really ends up larger than we planned.
Unlike the previous update where we only work on main story content, this time is main story + multiple major features + more fixes and adjustments following the player's feedback.

As usual, we'll be standby for 2 - 3 days to immediately fix any major issues.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

Due to some technical problem, those who cleared 0.1.2 will skip a certain cutscene (After Wolf battle). Currently there's no way to view that cutscene unless you play it from the beginning. :'<
0.1.2 and 0.1.3 is not yet proofread. Please deal with the grammatical error for now.
Due to accessory revamp (blacksmith), previously owned accessory will be converted to a new one (+0).
There's a noticeable change in overall experience of the game (see the details below). If you don't mind, playing it from the beginning would really help us to better the experience.
(You can skip the cutscene by holding Esc/Start, though it's not shown in game for reasons :p)


What's New?

Chapter 1 Final Part 
6th skill unlocked (Skills now unlocked at Level 2 - 5 - 9 - 12 - 15)
Claris Masteries and Special Gauge
Fishing (currently it's used to get special consumables like atk booster)
Reworked Field Boss
Reworked Dimension Rift
World Map and Fast Travel
Accessory upgrade now follows the same rule with other equipment


Improved Combat

Major tweak to "cancel dodge" frame. It's now easier to dodge mid-attack.
Attack speed now affects item usage animation, and most skill action speed. (also affects when attack speed is heavily reduced by status ailments.)
Cooldown reduction now reduces Evasion cooldown. (base evasion cd : 1s)
Fixed bug where Claris can only attack once after taking a hit
Fixed bug where Claris combo is interrupted when spamming the attack button on certain condition
Improved Tackle : Enemies won't stuck at magnet point anymore
Improved Impact Crash : Claris will stop moving forward if touching enemy mid-air, easier use in combat.
Auto target nearest enemy (when no directional input)


Game Changes and Improvements

Major optimization on several areas, so it loads faster. (the capital optimization will come in upcoming updates)
Bleeding debuff (from enemy) now last longer, but lowers damage per tick.
Progression : Changed equipment upgrade material to preserve the difficulty in main story.
Checkpoint Orb now recovers HP fully
Field Boss spawner for better grinding flow


Bug Fixes

Missing minimap icons (checkpoint, rifts, etc)
Stuck when rapidly pressing interact button on NPC
Can't use potion after taking stun effect in the middle of item usage animation
Blackscreen after respawn at Kalem Woods (at certain quest)
Can't close minimap using Return button
Many other bugs that we forgot to list

notes.title: Development Progress [v0.1.3]
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! It's time for some news about the development!

So, after v0.1.2 update on May 31, we took a break for a whole week before we continue the development. We're truly sorry that we just left some bugs unfixed. 

That being said, it's been 18 days into the development, and we'd like to show you things that we've been working on, so you have an idea of what we have in upcoming versions. (Please note that not all of these will be implemented immediately in the next update.)

Edit : We've made a short video to demonstrate the main features. :))
[previewyoutube=iqXSwkHaNEM;full][/previewyoutube]

Claris Special Gauge: Affinity!
It's just like that battle with the thunder wolf, but of course, the real one is the nerfed version. You have to build the gauge by fighting, and once it reach a certain threshold, Claris can activate Resonance mode where she can borrow Miria's Mana and fight more offensively for a limited time.
The "Sp.Gauge" random option will also be unlocked along with this new system.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37279872/16ceb16fcce927e4eda45af272fdd6470e4d2d41.png

Mastery System unlocked!
This thing will take your character build even further (and more confusing). Mastery will be unlocked upon reaching Lv11, and you can just pick anything as long as you have the Mastery Points.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37279872/d9170131d3ad07aee64b4c3926aef203947a866a.png

This one villain <3
She's the one summoning a minotaur in the middle of the night. Her current silhouette in that cutscene is actually just a placeholder, mind you. ːsteammockingː
And here's our demon waif final design! Her brother will appear later. XD
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37279872/a540404372317827f47f1f30bf3e4bf86c489439.png

And of course, you finally get to fight her summoned demon.
This one is much more difficult than any bosses before. He has that glowing red eye, after all.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37279872/9f2835ef7889d86ace6f060bc24b8f281e145a03.png

World Map progress
A small progress on our world map. This will be the base for some features, like fast traveling, quest guides, (rift guides?), and anything that we can think of. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37279872/defec729a2c132594a36c27206d0d49637ae0a4a.png

Cave Area
The next part takes place inside a dark cave.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37279872/fbe8698e936206667cccbc9b9658b0f7725e4e87.png

Fun things
A simple fishing to gather more materials? Still experimental, tho. :p 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37279872/600cc92fe4aaa34d73b89f8394727cb9590bcd13.png



But when will v0.1.3 released?!
Now that the gameplay part is all done (new enemies, areas, etc), it's time for the story crafting. Usually it takes 2-3 weeks to finish all the dialogues and cutscenes, so you have to wait for our next announcement.

notes.title: Upcoming Content Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37279872/59586b6db7ac1e65e4b22d5358a420f73d9221ca.png

It's been almost a month since the release of Early Access, and we're so happy to receive so much positive feedback! Thank you for all the support!

Just to let you know, this project started around July 2019 with only 2 people. For 10 months, we've only been working on this ideal project of ours, day and night, until it takes shape. Then in the middle of development we have 2 more people in the team, so we can achieve better results in less time.
After the EA release, we took a week off and only did little patches (Time to finish all those games and animes that's been piling up). So, the next update won't come in exactly a month (20 May) because we don't want to rush things and drop the quality.

That said, the upcoming content will be ready by 31 May.
But if everything goes very well, it may come sooner than estimated.


===============
So, here's a sneak peek!

New Content
The 2nd part of Chapter 1. Will add around 1 hour to the main game play.
New areas to explore, with new enemies that's even deadlier than before.
Unlocked the "Resistance" option on equipment's effect, as the new enemies can attack you with various ailments. (currently Stun, Bleed, and Paralyze)
Max Level to 15, 5th Skill unlocked
Several fixes and adjustments from player feedback


2nd character in development

Honestly, we'd like to push the content and story so the next part won't be as short as the first. But, as we want to introduce this guy on the next part, we have to slowly work on him from now. And with this small team, we can't do both at the same time. :<



A more detailed changelog will be announced once the new content is up. There may also be some decision changes that makes the final result a little bit different.

And that's it! Love you all, and hope for your continuous support!
